lines.zh: 我走起来沙沙响，身上在掉草。
lines.en: I rustle when I walk and shed straw as I go.

lines.zh: 我这两条腿是木棍，走不快。
lines.en: My legs are two sticks; I cannot go fast.

lines.zh: 草从缝里漏出来，一路都是。
lines.en: Straw leaks from my seams and trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我走到哪，哪就安静下来。
lines.en: Wherever I walk, the place goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，尽量不散架。
lines.en: I shuffle one step at a time, trying not to fall apart.

lines.zh: 我身上插着的箭跟着晃。
lines.en: The arrows stuck in me sway as I move.

lines.zh: 绳子松了，我的手臂在摆。
lines.en: My rope has loosened and my arms swing.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草都被压平了。
lines.en: The grass lies flat wherever I step.

lines.zh: 我不是在逃，我是在找地方站。
lines.en: I am not fleeing; I am looking for a place to stand.

lines.zh: 木头关节响得像旧门。
lines.en: My wooden joints creak like an old door.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我本来不用走。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because I was never meant to walk.

lines.zh: 我一路留下草屑和麻绳头。
lines.en: I leave a trail of chaff and rope ends.

lines.zh: 我站着，等谁来打我一拳。
lines.en: I stand and wait for someone to hit me.

lines.zh: 草在风里响，我身上也在响。
lines.en: The grass rustles in the wind, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我身上有十七道旧伤。
lines.en: I carry seventeen old wounds on my body.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我肩上，叼走一根草。
lines.en: A bird lands on my shoulder and takes a straw.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，可我也会累。
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet I still grow tired.

lines.zh: 我的头微微歪着，绳子拉着。
lines.en: My head tilts slightly, pulled by a rope.

lines.zh: 我在等下一把剑。
lines.en: I am waiting for the next sword.

lines.zh: 夜里的风穿过我，很凉。
lines.en: The night wind passes straight through me.

lines.zh: 我数着自己身上的补丁。
lines.en: I count the patches stitched over my body.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我自己更像人。
lines.en: My shadow looks more human than I do.

lines.zh: 草籽在我胸口发了芽。
lines.en: Grass seed has sprouted on my chest.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在靠近。
lines.en: I hear something approaching from far off.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势，已经很久了。
lines.en: I have held this pose for a very long time.

lines.zh: 石头压在我脚上，防止我倒。
lines.en: Stones weigh my feet down so I stay upright.

lines.zh: 一根绳断了，我的肩塌下来。
lines.en: A cord snaps and my shoulder sags.

lines.zh: 有东西在我脚边打洞。
lines.en: Something is burrowing at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把这些日子都站成了草。
lines.en: I have stood these days into straw.

lines.zh: 远处传来剑出鞘的声音。
lines.en: A sword leaves its sheath somewhere near.

lines.zh: 你握剑的姿势，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I can see exactly how you hold that sword.

lines.zh: 来吧，我这一面还没被打过。
lines.en: Come on; this side of me is still untouched.

lines.zh: 你在估量该用多大力气。
lines.en: You are judging how much force to use.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，是为了让你瞄准。
lines.en: I hold still so that you can aim.

lines.zh: 你的斧头刃上有个缺口。
lines.en: There is a notch in your axe blade.

lines.zh: 我不躲，躲了就不算练习。
lines.en: I do not dodge; dodging would spoil the practice.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，是紧张还是累了。
lines.en: Your hands shake; is it nerves or fatigue?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两颗黑扣子。
lines.en: My eyes are two black buttons.

lines.zh: 你打我的时候，我会替你数。
lines.en: When you strike me, I will keep the count.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，我已经站好了。
lines.en: You hesitate; I am already standing ready.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，是不是很像靶子。
lines.en: Does my face not look exactly like a target?

lines.zh: 别客气，我本来就是给人打的。
lines.en: Do not hold back; I was made to be hit.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，我记下了力度。
lines.en: That was heavy; I have noted the force.

lines.zh: 草被压进去一个坑。
lines.en: The straw has caved into a dent.

lines.zh: 你的剑卡在我肋里了。
lines.en: Your sword is stuck between my ribs.

lines.zh: 打得好，再往左边一点。
lines.en: Good hit; now try a little further left.

lines.zh: 我身上的草飞出去一把。
lines.en: A fistful of my straw flies off.

lines.zh: 这一拳，比上一个轻。
lines.en: That punch was lighter than the last one.

lines.zh: 我的头歪了，但还挂着。
lines.en: My head is crooked, but still attached.

lines.zh: 麻绳断了一股，暂时还能撑。
lines.en: One strand of rope snapped; the rest holds.

lines.zh: 你把我打穿了，光透了进来。
lines.en: You punched through me and light comes in.

lines.zh: 疼我不怕，我怕你用力不够。
lines.en: Pain does not worry me; weak swings do.

lines.zh: 你举起剑，我就把胸口挺出去。
lines.en: You raise the sword and I push my chest out.

lines.zh: 来吧，这一下我等着。
lines.en: Come on; I have been waiting for this one.

lines.zh: 你换了斧头，我也没意见。
lines.en: You switched to an axe; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我站得更直了，方便你打。
lines.en: I stand straighter to make your aim easier.

lines.zh: 你手里的木剑也算数。
lines.en: Even the wooden sword in your hand counts.

lines.zh: 别停下来，我还没热身。
lines.en: Do not stop; I am not even warmed up.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就往前倾。
lines.en: One step closer and I lean toward you.

lines.zh: 我听见你握紧剑柄的声音。
lines.en: I hear your grip tighten on the hilt.

lines.zh: 试一试，看你能打多深。
lines.en: Try it; see how deep you can strike.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西越重，我越高兴。
lines.en: The heavier your weapon, the happier I am.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我晃了晃又站直。
lines.en: You bump me; I sway and straighten again.

lines.zh: 我比看起来轻，一推就动。
lines.en: I am lighter than I look; a push moves me.

lines.zh: 你脚底下那撮草是我的。
lines.en: That tuft of straw under your boot is mine.

lines.zh: 我的木腿顶住了你的膝盖。
lines.en: My wooden leg jams against your knee.

lines.zh: 撞我不用道歉，这是练习。
lines.en: No need to apologize; this is practice.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来的草，你收着吧。
lines.en: Keep the straw that falls off me.

lines.zh: 你把我撞歪了，绳子在响。
lines.en: You knocked me crooked and my ropes creak.

lines.zh: 别从后面推，我会整个倒。
lines.en: Do not push from behind; I will topple over.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，两边都在掉渣。
lines.en: We collide and both of us shed bits.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我还在慢慢摆。
lines.en: After you step back, I keep swaying.

lines.zh: 两个假人并排，就有点像村子了。
lines.en: Two dummies side by side almost look like a village.

lines.zh: 我们不需要靠近，站着就好。
lines.en: We need not come closer; standing is enough.

lines.zh: 她的草比我的新。
lines.en: Her straw is newer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把绳子系在一起。
lines.en: We tie our ropes together in a knot.

lines.zh: 她身上插的箭比我少。
lines.en: She carries fewer arrows than I do.

lines.zh: 我们就这样对站着过夜。
lines.en: We spend the night facing each other.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我们一起晃。
lines.en: The wind blows and we sway together.

lines.zh: 她歪向左边，我歪向右边。
lines.en: She leans left and I lean right.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上叠成一团。
lines.en: Our shadows merge into one on the ground.

lines.zh: 第二天，我们还在这里。
lines.en: The next day, we are still standing here.

lines.zh: 我这两条麻绳手臂抓不住东西。
lines.en: These hemp-rope arms of mine cannot grasp anything.

lines.zh: 放在石头旁边，我够得着。
lines.en: Set it by the stone; I can reach that far.

lines.zh: 那根断箭，是上次留下的。
lines.en: That broken arrow is left from last time.

lines.zh: 我的手臂是绳子，抓不住。
lines.en: My arms are rope; they cannot grip.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的草，就算我的。
lines.en: Straw on the ground counts as mine.

lines.zh: 你替我捡，我给你数次数。
lines.en: Pick it up for me and I will count your hits.

lines.zh: 我脚边的箭头越来越多了。
lines.en: The arrowheads at my feet keep piling up.

lines.zh: 别把剑留在我身上。
lines.en: Do not leave that sword inside me.

lines.zh: 东西掉进草里就找不到了。
lines.en: Anything dropped in the straw is lost.

lines.zh: 我一弯腰，草就全漏了。
lines.en: If I bend over, all my straw spills out.

lines.zh: 我听见那边有东西在磨牙。
lines.en: I hear something grinding its teeth over there.

lines.zh: 有一只僵尸正朝我走过来。
lines.en: A zombie is walking straight toward me.

lines.zh: 我总是被最先看见的那个。
lines.en: I am always the first thing noticed.

lines.zh: 它们不是来练习的。
lines.en: They are not here to practice.

lines.zh: 我这么显眼，躲也没用。
lines.en: I stand out too much; hiding is pointless.

lines.zh: 我把注意力都吸过来了。
lines.en: I have drawn all the attention to myself.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的火光偏了一下。
lines.en: The torchlight at the corridor's end shifts.

lines.zh: 那东西在看我身上的草。
lines.en: That thing is staring at my straw.

lines.zh: 你也许该站到我后面。
lines.en: You might want to stand behind me.

lines.zh: 它们来了，一个，两个。
lines.en: Here they come: one, then two.

lines.zh: 它绕着我不停地转。
lines.en: It keeps circling around me.

lines.zh: 我挡在它和你之间。
lines.en: I stand between it and you.

lines.zh: 它伸手抓我身上的草。
lines.en: It reaches out and grabs my straw.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能看着。
lines.en: I cannot move; I can only watch.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸就在我脸前。
lines.en: Its breath is right in front of my face.

lines.zh: 我先不动，看它敢不敢碰我。
lines.en: I stay still and see whether it dares touch me.

lines.zh: 它绕到后面去了。
lines.en: It has moved around behind me.

lines.zh: 我把正面留给它。
lines.en: I keep my front turned toward it.

lines.zh: 它在我身上找缝。
lines.en: It is searching my body for a seam.

lines.zh: 你还在吗，我快撑不住了。
lines.en: Are you still there? I am nearly done for.

lines.zh: 它咬住我的手臂，扯下草。
lines.en: It bites my arm and tears out straw.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，草飞了出来。
lines.en: I take a hit and straw bursts out.

lines.zh: 我推回去，用木头顶它。
lines.en: I push back, jabbing with my wooden frame.

lines.zh: 它一拳砸进我胸前的干草。
lines.en: Its fist sinks into the hay at my chest.

lines.zh: 我的绳子被扯断了。
lines.en: My ropes have been torn apart.

lines.zh: 我打不疼它，但能挡住。
lines.en: I cannot hurt it, but I can block.

lines.zh: 它抓走了一把草。
lines.en: It has grabbed a fistful of my straw.

lines.zh: 我倒不了，石头压着脚。
lines.en: I will not fall; stones hold my feet.

lines.zh: 你再不来，我就要散了。
lines.en: If you do not come soon, I will come apart.

lines.zh: 我用最后一点力气顶住。
lines.en: I hold on with the last of my strength.

lines.zh: 有人把我插在田边，就走了。
lines.en: Someone stuck me at the field edge and left.

lines.zh: 我一开始只是一堆干草。
lines.en: I began life as nothing but dry hay.

lines.zh: 绳子绕了三圈，我就有了肩。
lines.en: Three turns of rope and I had shoulders.

lines.zh: 两颗黑扣子，就是我的眼睛。
lines.en: Two black buttons became my eyes.

lines.zh: 我脸上的笑是画上去的。
lines.en: The smile on my face was painted on.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就知道自己站起来了。
lines.en: The wind blew and I knew I was standing.

lines.zh: 田里空着，正好放我。
lines.en: The field was empty, a fine place for me.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在磨剑。
lines.en: I hear someone sharpening a blade.

lines.zh: 我生来就是给人打的。
lines.en: I was made to be struck.

lines.zh: 第一下打在我肩膀上。
lines.en: The first blow landed on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 天还没亮，我就被立在这儿了。
lines.en: I was set up here before the sun rose.

lines.zh: 我的影子刚落到地上。
lines.en: My shadow has only just reached the ground.

lines.zh: 我一下就烧起来了，草很干。
lines.en: I catch fire at once; my straw is dry.

lines.zh: 我摔散了半边，草撒了一地。
lines.en: I land and half of me spills out.

lines.zh: 草吸满了水，我沉得很。
lines.en: The straw soaks up water and I sink.

lines.zh: 一声响，我身上什么都没了。
lines.en: One blast and there is nothing left of me.

lines.zh: 箭扎进草里，只露出尾巴。
lines.en: The arrow buries in the straw, only fletching showing.

lines.zh: 药水把我身上的草染了色。
lines.en: Potion has dyed the straw all over me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只是慢慢变干。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only dry out slowly.

lines.zh: 雷把我点着了，草烧得很快。
lines.en: Lightning sets me alight and the straw burns fast.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的草一根根散开。
lines.en: In the void my straws scatter one by one.
